from.place: The finite Koszul model of derived completion in def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback; Tag 0A0E identifies the negative finite complex with the dual of the positive one. This node isolates splitting off the first exterior koszul generator. This node isolates the contraction equation on a head-tail summand.

title: The contraction equation on a head-tail summand
statement: For every commutative ring A, natural r,m, coefficient list a : Fin(r+1) to A and integers p,q, the explicit multiplication map of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-join-graded] from the tensor summand (p,q) to degree p+q of completedKoszulPower(r+1,a,m) intertwines the outgoing differential with the sum of head contraction and tail contraction multiplied by the cochain tensor sign epsilon_2(p,q). The two resulting summand maps have indices (p+1,q) and (p,q+1). This is the local Leibniz formula, before taking the total coproduct and with no invertibility or transition assertion.

source.place: Tag 0664, lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex, proof hint: exterior generators of the two factors and their Koszul differentials.

proof.text: If either source cochain index is positive, the summand map is zero by definition and the differential out of that positive term vanishes by extension by zero. Both sides of the equation simplify to zero.

If both source indices are nonpositive, apply the nonpositive-degree contraction equation, whose proof uses injective exterior coordinates, contraction naturality, the graded Leibniz rule and the degree-zero boundary calculations.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0622 and 0664; existing positive-degree argument by E4, with nonpositive-degree proof completed by T4.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulJoinSummand_leibniz
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A)
    (m : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) :
    koszulJoinSummand (A := A) r a m p q (p + q) rfl ≫
        (completedKoszulPower (A := A) (r + 1) a m).d (p + q) (p + q + 1) =
      ((completedKoszulPower (A := A) 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m).d p (p + 1) ⊗ₘ 𝟙 _) ≫
          koszulJoinSummand r a m (p + 1) q (p + q + 1) (by omega) +
        ComplexShape.ε₂ (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (p, q) •
          ((𝟙 _ ⊗ₘ
            (completedKoszulPower (A := A) r (fun j ↦ a j.succ) m).d q (q + 1)) ≫
              koszulJoinSummand r a m p (q + 1) (p + q + 1) (by omega))
